summary: Recent updates to WebRTC, the technology behind video calls, have introduced the capability to track changes in selected candidate pairs for transport statistics. This means that developers can now better understand how their applications handle different network conditions by seeing which network routes (or candidates) are being selected during a call. The ability to monitor these changes is crucial for optimizing video and audio quality and ultimately enhances the user experience during live communications. **This improvement allows for more responsive handling of network fluctuations, making video calls smoother and more reliable.**
